method: Compare existing account distribution and vendor co-selling route, not inferred referrals; observations from issuer annual filings and official vendor/issuer partner pages; different periods and denominators

definitions.customer_critical_mass: Client count, account depth, retention, share of revenue from longstanding accounts and ability to upsell within installed base
definitions.referral_base: Measured partner-sourced leads, co-sell qualified pipeline and partner-originated booked revenue; publicly unverified unless quantified
definitions.partner_preference: Tier designation, vendor-led joint GTM, co-designed solutions, active projects and contractual exclusivity are distinct categories; do not infer referrals or favored sourcing from badges

companies.installed_base_evidence: ~75% Fortune Global 100/500, 317 Diamond clients, 85% top 200 commercial relationships 20+ years
companies.nvidia: Joint NVIDIA Business Group; NVIDIA AI Refinery; issuer reports >45k professionals trained on NVIDIA technology
companies.microsoft: Avanade joint venture and 20 Global SI Partner of Year wins; Microsoft alliance says 176k+ specialists includes Accenture, Avanade and Microsoft; NOT Accenture-alone staff
companies.commercial_preference: deep joint delivery confirmed; exclusive preferred customer referral terms not verified

companies.microsoft: Globally managed enterprise systems integrator, 2025 Microsoft Innovate with Azure AI Platform award
companies.commercial_preference: Global-managed tier verified; quantifiable vendor-originated leads unverified

companies.nvidia: NVIDIA Center of Excellence, NVIDIA stack integrations and transaction foundation model
companies.commercial_preference: joint product solution evidence; partner-sourced bookings unverified

companies.microsoft: Microsoft Digital Agency & AI Inner Circle Partner issuer listed
companies.nvidia: issuer listed partnership; tier/referral volume unverified
companies.commercial_preference: vendor referral volume unverified; proven installed-base persistence

companies.nvidia: official Solution Advisor Partner, joint NVIDIA use cases
companies.microsoft: Microsoft cloud consulting partner, Azure marketplace
companies.commercial_preference: partner-influenced revenue disclosed at $21.5m Q3 but vendor-specific attribution not verified

conclusions: ACN strongest established joint partner distribution but enterprise scale dilutes pure AI upside
EPAM strongest specialist platform with Microsoft account/referral access evidence; organic acceleration remains uncertain
EXLS strongest domain installed-base plus NVIDIA/MSFT implementation evidence; vendor lead volume unknown
GLOB strong client persistence but weak current earnings conversion relative to narrative
GDYN highest productivity leverage but high customer concentration; NVIDIA Solution Advisor not proven preferred sourcing
epistemic_rule: No partner preference or exclusivity asserted without documented vendor-side commercial contract or sourcing data
